versions.changelog:
**Major update: Complete redesign and rebranding of the skill, now focused on real-time sector research for China A-shares with global news integration.**

- Skill renamed to "ai-stock-insider" and upgraded to version 3.0.0.
- Now delivers professional real-time sector reports: live market data, news, US stock linkage, and major events.
- Added fixed, comprehensive markdown report layout for all outputs to ensure consistency and completeness.
- Zero-setup, out-of-the-box compatibility with Feishu, Coze, and other Markdown platforms.
- Optional integration with Tavily API for enhanced news coverage.
- Workflow optimized to minimize LLM API usage, focusing LLM only on in-depth user-requested analysis.
- Expanded and clarified documentation for supported sectors, usage methods, and working process.
